title: Duel de Capricare
identity: IRCAM identifies Henri Pousseur’s Duel de Capricares (1996) as a mobile for alto saxophone and piano, lasting 12–15 minutes. CiNii's library record for the 1997 reproduced holograph says the saxophone part derives from Caprices de Saxicare and that a new piano part was added. This supports a title/version relationship with the local record, though the catalogue’s singular spelling differs from the IRCAM title.
